indicators: Inputs (source declarations): atrPeriod = input(10, "ATR Length", group = "Supertrend"); factor = input.float(3.0, "Factor", step = 0.01, group = "Supertrend"); useStartPeriodTime = input.bool(true, "Start", group = "Date Range", inline = "Start Period"); startPeriodTime = input.time(timestamp("4 Jan 2002"), "", group = "Date Range", inline = "Start Period"); useEndPeriodTime = input.bool(true, "End", group = "Date Range", inline = "End Period"); endPeriodTime = input.time(timestamp("31 Dec 2031"), "", group = "Date Range", inline = "End Period"); tp1Open = input.bool(true, "TP1", group = "Take Profits"); tp1 = input.float(2.0, "TP Level (%)", step = 0.1, group = "Take Profits") / 100; tp1Amount = input.int(25, "Amount (%)", step = 1, group = "Take Profits"); tp2Open = input.bool(true, "TP2", group = "Take Profits"); tp2 = input.float(5.0, "TP Level (%)", step = 0.1, group = "Take Profits") / 100; tp2Amount = input.int(50, "Amount (%)", step = 1, group = "Take Profits"); tp3Open = input.bool(true, "TP3", group = "Take Profits"); tp3 = input.float(10.0, "TP Level (%)", step = 0.1, group = "Take Profits") / 100; tp3Amount = input.int(25, "Amount (%)", step = 1, group = "Take Profits"); tp4Open = input.bool(false, "TP4", group = "Take Profits"); tp4 = input.float(0, "TP Level (%)", step = 0.1, group = "Take Profits") / 100; tp4Amount = input.int(0, "Amount (%)", step = 1, group = "Take Profits") | Indicator calls: ta.supertrend(factor, atrPeriod)
entry_long: Source rule: inDateRange with all conditions true ta.change(direction)  is below  0
entry_short: Source rule: inDateRange with all conditions true ta.change(direction)  exceeds  0
exit: Source rule: (tp1Open); order: strategy.exit ("TP1", from_entry="LONG", limit=entryPrice * (1 + tp1), qty_percent=tp1Amount); Source rule: (tp1Open); order: strategy.exit ("TP1", from_entry="SHORT", limit=entryPrice * (1 - tp1), qty_percent=tp1Amount); Source rule: (tp2Open); order: strategy.exit ("TP2", from_entry="LONG", limit=entryPrice * (1 + tp2), qty_percent=tp2Amount); Source rule: (tp2Open); order: strategy.exit ("TP2", from_entry="SHORT", limit=entryPrice * (1 - tp2), qty_percent=tp2Amount); Source rule: (tp3Open); order: strategy.exit ("TP3", from_entry="LONG", limit=entryPrice * (1 + tp3), qty_percent=tp3Amount); Source rule: (tp3Open); order: strategy.exit ("TP3", from_entry="SHORT", limit=entryPrice * (1 - tp3), qty_percent=tp3Amount); Source rule: (tp4Open); order: strategy.exit ("TP4", from_entry="LONG", limit=entryPrice * (1 + tp4), qty_percent=tp4Amount); Source rule: (tp4Open); order: strategy.exit ("TP4", from_entry="SHORT", limit=entryPrice * (1 - tp4), qty_percent=tp4Amount)
take_profit: strategy.exit ("TP1", from_entry="LONG", limit=entryPrice * (1 + tp1), qty_percent=tp1Amount); strategy.exit ("TP1", from_entry="SHORT", limit=entryPrice * (1 - tp1), qty_percent=tp1Amount); strategy.exit ("TP2", from_entry="LONG", limit=entryPrice * (1 + tp2), qty_percent=tp2Amount); strategy.exit ("TP2", from_entry="SHORT", limit=entryPrice * (1 - tp2), qty_percent=tp2Amount); strategy.exit ("TP3", from_entry="LONG", limit=entryPrice * (1 + tp3), qty_percent=tp3Amount); strategy.exit ("TP3", from_entry="SHORT", limit=entryPrice * (1 - tp3), qty_percent=tp3Amount); strategy.exit ("TP4", from_entry="LONG", limit=entryPrice * (1 + tp4), qty_percent=tp4Amount); strategy.exit ("TP4", from_entry="SHORT", limit=entryPrice * (1 - tp4), qty_percent=tp4Amount); strategy.exit ("TP5", from_entry="LONG", limit=entryPrice * (1 + tp5), qty_percent=tp5Amount); strategy.exit ("TP5", from_entry="SHORT", limit=entryPrice * (1 - tp5), qty_percent=tp5Amount)
